sources.title: GitHub - msxie92/MangaInpainting: Implementation for "Seamless Manga ...
sources.snippet: We present the first manga inpainting method, a deep learning model, that generates high-quality results. Instead of direct inpainting, we propose to separate the complicated inpainting into two major phases, semantic inpainting and appearance synthesis.

sources.title: ANIMADEX — Anime character & artist catalogue for the ANIMA AI model
sources.snippet: A catalogue of over 36,000 anime characters and 15,000 artists rendered with the ANIMA AI model. Searchable by tags, copyright, hair colour, eye colour, gender and CivitAI LoRA availability.
